equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (12) steady integral energy
equations.quote: integral energy equation through the channel
equations.form: d/dx[ iint_A (rho*u*H0) dA ] dx = iint_{A_w} q_w dA_w,  H0 = H + u^2/2
equations.description: One-dimensional energy balance (the equation used in 1-D approaches).

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (13) slice energy balance
equations.quote: has to be written for a slice of height
equations.description: Energy balance written for a slice of height dy.

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (14) radial turbulent heat flux
equations.quote: is due to the turbulent mixing, then
equations.description: Radial heat flux in the coolant due to turbulent mixing.

variables.meaning: average turbulent conductivity in the radial direction

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (15) turbulent conductivity correlation (Kacynski)
equations.quote: as proposed in reference [25] in the case of a smooth
equations.description: Average radial turbulent conductivity from the mean Reynolds number and mean fluid conductivity (bulk-temperature based), proposed in [25] for a smooth wall.
assumptions: assumed also valid for rough walls because of the lack of modeling

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (16) quasi-2-D energy equation
equations.description: Energy balance with the turbulent-conduction closure; all variables except k_t depend on x and y.

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (17) wall heat-transfer coefficient
equations.quote: the wall heat flux can be related to the coolant and wall temperature using
equations.description: Wall heat flux from a transfer coefficient.

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (18) Nusselt number with variable-property correction
equations.quote: for the Nusselt number are in the following general form
equations.description: Constant-property rough-tube Nusselt number Nu0(Re, Pr, eps) times a correction C_h that mainly depends on T_w/T; evaluated at local y on the lateral wall.

variables.meaning: constant-property Nusselt number Nu0(Re, Pr, eps)

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (19) general equations of state
equations.quote: can be obtained by suitable equations of state
equations.form: p = p(rho, T) and H = H(rho, T)
equations.description: Density and temperature are the independent variables; pressure and enthalpy from any suitable EOS.

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (20) general transport-property relations
equations.quote: can be evaluated by proper thermodynamic relations
equations.form: mu = mu(rho, T) and k = k(rho, T)
equations.description: Viscosity and conductivity from proper thermodynamic relations; the model refers to no particular EOS.

equations.label: Pizzarelli 2011 Eq. (21) velocity-temperature variation hypothesis
equations.quote: the velocity variation relative to its mean value is equal to the temperature variation
equations.description: Relative velocity variation in the section set equal to relative temperature variation (basis of the velocity-profile model).
